## About
We're a family-owned-and-operated shop in El Monte, and our owners live and work right here in the San Gabriel Valley. We really enjoy serving our customers and repairing automobiles, and we keep our pricing no-nonsense so you get the work you need.
Brakes and wheels are in our name, but we handle much more: alignment, tires, AC and heat, tune-ups, oil changes, diagnostics and clutch work. We keep our own parts department on site, along with the latest equipment for your repair and service needs.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 85 Google reviews. One longtime customer told us they still drive in from the high desert for anything more complicated than an oil change.

## Services
- Brake repair: Expert brake work on cars, trucks and RVs, domestic and imported, including brake pads and rotors. We suggest a brake check every time you come in for an oil change.
- Suspension and alignment: Precise diagnosis of your suspension, chassis and alignment so the problem is pinpointed and you save time and money.
- New tires: New tires help your car handle better and can save you money on gas.
- AC and heat: We look over your AC system's performance and its parts so you stay comfortable around town and on road trips.
- General auto repair and tune-ups: Repair and maintenance on all makes and models, foreign and domestic, including RVs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on RVs?
A: Yes. We provide brake repair on cars, trucks and RVs, and our general repair covers RVs as well.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We work on both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Can you handle my scheduled dealer maintenance?
A: Yes. Bring your vehicle to us for scheduled maintenance and save money compared to the dealer.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
